contract.coordinates: translation and picking halo use CSS pixels; world and camera use doubles. Device matrix includes camera, DPR, ancestor transforms, and internal raster supersampling.
contract.precision: epsilon_local <= epsilon_device / sigma_max(full linear transform). CPU fill flattened in device space; stroke centerline/round arcs use 0.125-device-pixel per-stage tolerance without 1e-6 local floor; device picking uses 1/64 CSS px and 5 CSS px halo.
contract.budgets: stroke arcs explicitly reject >131072 subdivisions; uniform and variable-width stroke expansion reject >2000000 output points. These prevent silent segment-count coarsening; they are not a proof over all accepted numerical inputs.
contract.camera: shared screen/world conversion, zoomAt and fitBounds; repeated limit requests exactly preserve camera; latest editor state used by repeated controls; wheel deltaMode converted to CSS pixels
contract.presentation: previous bitmap temporarily CSS-transformed while current vector frame is pending; first 1x render, higher DPR after 180ms, max DPR2 and 4000000 display pixels; browser visual acceptance remains separate
contract.cache: Engine retains vector Paths/glyph outlines, not zoomed raster snapshots for final CPU output
contract.not_proven: arbitrary nested transforms/cusps/offset curves, all mask/editing paths, all AA phases, total end-to-end error, interactive latency, full Figma parity
